instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Implement a pipelined module that converts an 8-bit binary number into BCD format. 
The module should have one input (BIN) and four outputs (BCD_HIGH1, BCD_LOW1, BCD_HIGH2, BCD_LOW2). 
The input BIN should be a binary number between 0 and 255. 
The outputs BCD_HIGH1 and BCD_LOW1 should represent the most significant 4 bits of the binary number in BCD format, 
and the outputs BCD_HIGH2 and BCD_LOW2 should represent the least significant 4 bits of the binary number in BCD format. 
Use pipeline structure to achieve this functionality.
